passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Field/site-based employees can claim safety equipment (PPE), such as safety boots, safety glasses and high-visibility clothing, up to $300 per year. Other roles cannot claim PPE; site visitors use the site's equipment. The yearly limit is per calendar year and covers all PPE you claim that year. Claim PPE like any other expense, with the receipt. Equipment must meet the safety standard the site requires; the site safety lead can advise.

passages.title: Employee Handbook & Code of Conduct
passages.text: Personal protective equipment (PPE) is required on every project site: safety boots, hard hat, high-visibility clothing and safety glasses as the site requires. Follow the site's safety plan and the instructions of the site safety lead. Field/site-based employees can be reimbursed for PPE under RSE-EXP-01 §7.1. Office staff who visit a site for a meeting or inspection must also wear the PPE the site requires; site teams keep spare equipment for visitors. You may stop work at any time if you believe it is unsafe, and you will never be penalised for doing so in good faith. Tell the site safety lead and your manager straight away so the hazard can be dealt with.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: When you combine business and personal travel, airfare is reimbursed up to the business-only comparison fare, which Ridgeline Travel quotes at booking for the dates the business trip alone would need.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Professional engineering licence renewals are reimbursed. Claim the renewal fee with the receipt. Fees for licences in additional jurisdictions are reimbursed when your manager agrees they are needed for your projects.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Alcohol is reimbursed only as part of pre-approved client entertainment.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: While travelling on business, meals are reimbursed up to $75 per day for domestic travel and up to $90 per day for international travel. Any amount over the daily cap is not reimbursed. The daily cap covers all your meals that day together, including tips. Domestic means travel within your own country; international means travel outside it. For example, a single dinner costing more than the domestic daily cap on a site visit is reimbursed only up to the cap, and you pay the difference. Meals provided by a client or included in a conference fee are not claimed again.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Hotel lodging is reimbursed up to $250 per night in the US and up to $275 per night outside the US (international), before taxes. Book through Ridgeline Travel. The nightly limit depends on where you stay, not where you are from: a Denver employee staying in Toronto uses the international limit. If no reasonable hotel is available within the limit, for example during a major event, ask your manager to approve the higher rate before booking and note the approval on your claim. Room service, minibar and in-room entertainment are personal costs.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Lodging and meals on personal days are not reimbursed. For example, if you attend meetings at another office for three days and stay on for a few days of vacation, Ridgeline reimburses lodging and meals for the business days within the limits in §4 and §5.1, and airfare up to the business-only comparison fare. Lodging and meals for the vacation days are yours, and the vacation days are PTO.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Client entertainment, such as a meal with a client, is reimbursed up to $100 per person and needs your manager's pre-approval. On your claim, list the people attended, their organisations and the business purpose. Entertainment for public officials needs extra care; check with your manager first. Gifts and hospitality you receive from others are covered by RSE-HB-01 §4.3.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Alcohol is reimbursed only as part of pre-approved client entertainment.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Attach an itemised receipt for every item of $25 or more. A card statement is not a receipt. Photograph paper receipts and attach them to your claim in the HR Portal. If a receipt is lost, explain on the claim; your manager decides whether to approve it.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Submit claims within 30 days of the expense. Claims older than 60 days are not reimbursed without a director exception. Submitting promptly helps projects bill clients accurately and helps Finance close each month. For a long trip, you may submit claims as you go rather than waiting until you return.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: All limits in this policy are in USD. Claims in other currencies are compared with the limits at the card rate or Finance's rate on the expense date. Enter the amount in the currency you paid, and the HR Portal converts it. Card fees for foreign transactions on a personal card are reimbursed if you show them on your statement.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Expense claims are approved by claim total. Your manager approves claims up to $1,000. Your director approves claims up to $5,000. The VP Finance approves claims above $5,000. See also the Approval Matrix (RSE-APR-01 §4). Questions go to Finance at expenses@ridgeline.example. Approvers check that each item is a genuine business expense, within the limits in this policy and supported by receipts. An approver may approve part of a claim and decline the rest; you will be told which items and why.
